recognize_zh: 中央一個大型巨噬細胞，細胞質內可見被吞入的完整紅血球輪廓、多顆洋紅色小顆粒（被吞噬的血小板）與少量深色顆粒，本身核被推擠，這就是吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Several intact ingested erythrocytes within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Numerous small magenta/purple granular bodies consistent with phagocytosed platelets, plus a few dark blue-black granules (possible hemosiderin/debris)
Macrophage nucleus/nuclei with open chromatin, partly obscured by ingested material
Background of maturing myeloid cells (promyelocyte/myelocyte, band and segmented neutrophils), lymphocytes and erythrocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing several intact phagocytosed erythrocytes and numerous small magenta granular bodies consistent with ingested platelets, together with a few dark pigment granules. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytic precursors, neutrophils and lymphocytes without increased blasts in this field. The findings represent hemophagocytosis; since hemophagocytic histiocytes are nonspecific, correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25) is required.

ddx.dx: Macrophage with ingested pigment or debris (e.g., after transfusion or iron overload)
ddx.vs: Iron-laden macrophages contain coarse blue-black hemosiderin confirmed by Prussian blue rather than intact erythrocytes and platelets.
Tingible body macrophages contain dense pyknotic nuclear fragments rather than intact red cells and platelets.
Organisms are uniform small oval bodies with a halo or kinetoplast, whereas platelet granules are irregular magenta granular clumps without internal structure.
Neoplastic histiocytes are cytologically atypical with nucleoli and form sheets, while this is a single bland macrophage in a normal-appearing marrow background.
